name: ElegantFin TV
description: Minimal ElegantFin design with native Jellyfin motion and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Add thin white focus outlines, an inset rounded Media Bar with browser-style controls, and transparent navigation without blur. Reuse user library links in the classic TV header. Keep native card motion and slide transitions. TV validation pending.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
